payload.summary: HKG_ANNUAL_LEAVE applies to: Worker Location = Hong Kong. HKG Annual Leave Accrual: 7 units rising to 14 units, by worker years of service (based on hire date) as of period start date, Annual - 1st Period of Calendar Year (based on Period End Date) or Mid-Period Hire. Unused balance does not carry over. Not yet known: unit of time (days or hours).

payload.summary: GBR_STATUTORY_HOLIDAY applies to workers meeting any of: (1) In Salaried Compensation Plan and Worker: Terminated Mid-Period and Worker's Company = UK as of PS Date and Worker Employee Type is Regular or Fixed Term Contract as of PS Date. (2) In Salaried Compensation Plan and Worker's Company = UK as of PE Date and Worker Employee Type is Regular or Fixed Term Contract as of PE Date. GBR Statutory Holiday (Days) Accrual: UK Statutory 28 days prorated based on FTE% when Worker: Hire Date <= Current Calendar Year Start Date (based on Period End Date); GBR Statutory Holiday Entitlement for Mid Year Hire when Worker: Current Calendar Year Hire Date (Not Terminated in Current Period), Start of Period. GBR Statutory Holiday (Days) Termination Accrual: GBR Statutory Holiday Entitlement Decision for Mid Year Termination when Worker: Hire Date <= Current Calendar Year Start Date (based on Period End Date); GBR Statutory Holiday Entitlement Decision for Mid Year Hire and Termination when Worker: Hire Date > Current Calendar Year Start Date (based on Period End Date), Worker: Terminated Mid-Period. GBR Vacation Buy (Days): 0 units, Start of Period (this accrual has a different accrual frequency). Up to 5 units carry over, expiring after 3 Months. Balance is capped at 33 units. Not yet known: unit of time (days or hours), what 'GBR Statutory Holiday Entitlement for Mid Year Hire' evaluates to, what 'GBR Statutory Holiday Entitlement Decision for Mid Year Termination' evaluates to, what 'GBR Statutory Holiday Entitlement Decision for Mid Year Hire and Termination' evaluates to.
